views: view1: แปลนคานและพื้น ชั้นที่ 2 1:150 — คาน B-series + คานกันสาด/ระเบียงยื่น R (this split: beam_plan)
view2: same drawing — ป้ายพื้น S3 / S4 / S5 / RS1 / RS2 + แผ่นพื้นสำเร็จรูป + บันได 1 (split: etc_plan, _view2_etc_plan_slab)
warnings: Floor-2 beams of S-05 (260 atomic segments). Classroom bays: B4 on rows D and A and on the thirds of D-B (C'/C'', scaled), B5 on row B in bays 4-15 (B4 in bays 1-3 and 17-19), B9 (0.35 x 0.80) on every interior grid line D-A, B10/B10/1 on the end walls.

Stair bays 3-4 / 16-17: B7 and B3 share the D-C line on grids 3/4/16/17 (stacked label 'B7/B3'; the sheet notes 'คาน B2และB3ระดับชานพัก', so B3 and B2 are at landing level) — written as two elements on the same refs. B1 on row C and B1 at the stair top, B4 on row B, B6 (C-B) and B8 (B-A) on the stair grid lines.

Cantilever ring at floor 2 (corridor/canopy 1.50): R5 cantilevers at every grid on the D side and the A side (R8/1, 2.00, at the stair grids carrying RS2), R3 edge beams on D''''/A' (R2 on A'' at the stair bays), R4/R1/R1/1/R3/1 around the two end-wall cantilevers B-A+1.50 (x -1.50 and 73.50). No D-side cantilever in the stair bays.

Conflicts recorded, not resolved by guessing: (1) stair-top beam position 5.45 (S-12 printed) vs plan drawn 5.33 vs S-15 '~1.94' from B6's end (6.06) — 5.45 used; (2) S-12 calls the stair-top beam B3 and the beam on row B 'B6' (0.35 wide), the plan calls them B1 and B4 — plan marks kept, flags on the segments.
